declaration-property-value-allowed-list.message: Not a design token. Shadows, radii and spacing come from src/styles/tokens.css — use var(--shadow-…|--radius-…|--space-…), or 0. The 4/8/12/16/24/32/48 scale is the whole scale; an animation runs exactly once.
